Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged memory?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'memory'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id

 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Which users started the most topics in Community?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Community'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which users started the most topics in Site Feedback?

       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Site Feedback'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which users started the most topics in Announcements?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Announcements'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Which posts received the most cry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'cry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which posts received the most laughing reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'laughing'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Which categories have the highest average likes per topic?

SELECT c.name,
       AVG(t.like_count)::numeric(10, 2) AS avg_likes
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY avg_likes DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

  FROM posts p

   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged images?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'images'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

  JOIN chat_messages cm

          cc.name

Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged jobs?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'jobs'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id

  FROM topics t

  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'oauth'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 30 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged accessibility?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'accessibility'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: I need a query for: Which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t

  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: I need a query for: Show me which posts received the most clap reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'clap'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: I need a query for: Which categories have the most topics tagged markdown?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'markdown'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 30 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged memory?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'memory'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 14 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which users started the most topics in Ux?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Ux'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c

  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sql'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged cdn?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'cdn'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 90 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,

Question: Discourse report request: Which posts received the most cry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'cry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 60 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which posts received the most thumbsdown reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'thumbsdown'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged ember?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'ember'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which posts received the most laughing reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'laughing'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which chat channels has user_0226 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0226'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged redis?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'redis'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which chat channels has user_0181 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0181'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged notifications?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'notifications'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged import?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'import'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged search?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged images?

  FROM topics t

  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'images'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0197'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged analytics?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'analytics'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged composer?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'composer'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id

Question: Discourse report request: Which chat channels has user_0056 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0056'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 30 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: How many topics are tagged slow?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'slow'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Discourse report request: What is the number of topics are tagged jobs?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'jobs'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Discourse report request: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged composer?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'composer'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Discourse report request: Show me which posts received the most clap reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'clap'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Discourse report request: Which categories have the most topics tagged mobile?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'mobile'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged security?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'security'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 30 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0310 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0310'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged billing?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'billing'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which users started the most topics in Ux?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Ux'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged sql?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sql'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged cdn?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'cdn'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0125 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0125'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 90 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged notifications?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'notifications'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id

          cc.name

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged digest?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'digest'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 1 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged sso?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sso'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged rails?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'rails'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which users started the most topics in Site Feedback?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Site Feedback'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which users started the most topics in Ux?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Ux'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: What is the number of topics are tagged spam?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which posts received the most cry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'cry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 60 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged ember?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'ember'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which posts received the most laughing reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'laughing'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0347 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0347'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged redis?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'redis'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0181 posted in?

  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0181'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged images?

    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged import?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'import'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged export?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt

  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'export'

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0369 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0369'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged search?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged import?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'import'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc

    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id

          cc.name

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0197 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0197'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged search?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 90 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged analytics?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'analytics'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0310 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0310'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged theme?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'theme'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which users started the most topics in Security?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Security'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: What is the number of topics are tagged security?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0343 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0343'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged composer?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'composer'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged reporting?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'reporting'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 1 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 180 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0347 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0347'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged oauth?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'oauth'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(*) AS post_count

 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: How many topics are tagged slow?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'slow'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0360 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0360'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0125 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0125'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 90 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Performance'

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which posts received the most tada reactions?

       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'tada'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

  JOIN chat_channels cc

 ORDER BY messages DESC,

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged security?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'security'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which chat channels has user_0343 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0343'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which categories have the most topics tagged billing?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'billing'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which posts received the most clap reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'clap'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Show me which chat channels has user_0323 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0323'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Write a PostgreSQL query for this Discourse question: Which users started the most topics in Uncategorized?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Uncategorized'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged security?

Question: Generate SQL: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0229 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0229'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which users started the most topics in Bugs?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Bugs'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0071'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged memory?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'memory'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 14 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0285 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0285'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'billing'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which users started the most topics in Ux?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Ux'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged accessibility?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'accessibility'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged sql?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sql'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged cdn?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'cdn'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(*) AS messages

    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id

          cc.name

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Which users started the most topics in Community?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Community'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged sql?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sql'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 7 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt

    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'digest'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 1 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged sso?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sso'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which users started the most topics in Site Feedback?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Site Feedback'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which users started the most topics in Announcements?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Announcements'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Which posts received the most cry reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'cry'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which chat channels has user_0252 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0252'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 60 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which posts received the most thumbsdown reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'thumbsdown'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;
