Question: Generate SQL: Which chat channels has user_0285 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0285'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged ember?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'ember'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: What is the number of topics are tagged notifications?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'notifications'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which posts received the most laughing reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'laughing'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged redis?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'redis'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'webhooks'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which users started the most topics in Marketplace?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Marketplace'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the highest average likes per topic?

SELECT c.name,
       AVG(t.like_count)::numeric(10, 2) AS avg_likes
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY avg_likes DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: What is the average number of posts per topic in Dev?

SELECT AVG(t.posts_count)::numeric(10, 2) AS avg_posts
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Dev'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged export?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'export'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Which chat channels has user_0369 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0369'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged search?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 90 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged images?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'images'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged spam?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'spam'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 180 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged postgres?

  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'postgres'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged search?

       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t

  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'search'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 90 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0197 posted in?

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0197'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0310'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0369 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0369'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u

    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Security'

 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 60 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id

 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged cdn?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'cdn'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged oauth?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'oauth'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0147 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0147'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 30 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: How many topics are tagged slow?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'slow'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0360 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0360'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which chat channels has user_0125 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0125'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 90 days?

       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username

Question: Generate SQL: Show the 5 most active chat channels in the last 60 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 7 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 10 users wrote the most posts in the last 14 days?

       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 60 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which posts received the most tada reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'tada'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 60 days?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY post_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 20 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which chat channels has user_0048 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0048'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged security?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'security'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged accessibility?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'accessibility'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Generate SQL: Which chat channels has user_0343 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0343'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged unread?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'unread'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Generate SQL: Show me which posts received the most clap reactions?

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(ru.id) AS reaction_count
  FROM discourse_reactions_reaction_users ru
  JOIN discourse_reactions_reactions rr
    ON rr.id = ru.reaction_id
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.id = ru.post_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE rr.reaction_value = 'clap'
 GROUP BY p.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY reaction_count DESC,
          p.id
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Generate SQL: Which categories have the most topics tagged markdown?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'markdown'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged security?

 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,

Question: Return the SQL for: Which 5 topics have the most likes in the last 14 days?

SELECT t.id,
       t.title,
       COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN post_actions pa
    ON pa.post_id = p.id
   AND pa.post_action_type_id = 2
 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY t.id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY like_count DESC,
          t.id
 LIMIT 5;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show the 10 most active chat channels in the last 30 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged login?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'login'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged memory?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'memory'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show the 20 most active chat channels in the last 14 days.

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(cm.id) AS message_count
  FROM chat_channels cc
  JOIN chat_messages cm
    ON cm.chat_channel_id = cc.id
 WHERE cm.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY message_count DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0310'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which users started the most topics in Ux?

SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Ux'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'accessibility'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged sql?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'sql'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged cdn?

SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
  JOIN topic_tags tt
    ON tt.topic_id = t.id
  JOIN tags tg
    ON tg.id = tt.tag_id
 WHERE tg.name = 'cdn'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY c.name
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          c.name
 LIMIT 10;

Question: Return the SQL for: What is the average number of posts per topic in Integrations?

SELECT AVG(t.posts_count)::numeric(10, 2) AS avg_posts
  FROM topics t
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Integrations'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: Last 500 posts that were edited by TL0/TL1 users. fighting human-driven copy-paste spam

SELECT p.id AS post_id,
       topic_id
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
 WHERE p.last_editor_id = p.user_id
   AND p.self_edits > 0
   AND (u.trust_level = 0 OR u.trust_level = 1)
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND t.archetype = 'regular'
 ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
 LIMIT 500;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: New Topics by Category. Lists all new topics ordered by category and creation_date. The query accepts a ‘months_ago’ parameter. It defaults to 0 to give you the stats for the current month.

WITH query_period AS (
        SELECT date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 months' AS period_start,
               date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 months' + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 second' AS period_end

       t.category_id
  FROM topics t
 RIGHT JOIN query_period qp
    ON t.created_at >= qp.period_start
   AND t.created_at <= qp.period_end
 WHERE t.user_id > 0
   AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY t.category_id,
          t.created_at DESC;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: Top 100 Active Topics. based on the number of replies, it accepts a ‘months_ago’ parameter, defaults to 1 to give results for the last calendar month.

WITH query_period AS (
        SELECT date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 months' AS period_start,
               date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 months' + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 second' AS period_end
       ) SELECT t.id AS topic_id,
       t.category_id,
       COUNT(p.id) AS reply_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON t.id = p.topic_id
  JOIN query_period qp
    ON p.created_at >= qp.period_start
   AND p.created_at <= qp.period_end
 WHERE t.archetype = 'regular'
   AND t.user_id > 0
 GROUP BY t.id
 ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC, t.score DESC
 LIMIT 100;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: Top 50 Quality Users. based on post score calculated using reply count, likes, incoming links, bookmarks, time spent and read count.

SELECT sum(p.score) / count(p) AS "average score per post",
       count(p.id) AS post_count,
       p.user_id
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = p.user_id
 WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 month'
   AND NOT u.admin
   AND u.active
 GROUP BY user_id,
          u.views
HAVING count(p.id) > 50
 ORDER BY sum(p.score) / count(p) DESC
 LIMIT 50;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: User Participation Statistics. Detailed statistics for the most active users.

WITH t AS (
        SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - ((0 + 30) * (INTERVAL '1 days')) AS START, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (0 * (INTERVAL '1 days')) AS END
       ),
       pr AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS visits,
               SUM(posts_read) AS posts_read
          FROM user_visits,
               t
         WHERE posts_read > 0
           AND visited_at > t.START
           AND visited_at < t. END
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       pc AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS posts_created
          FROM posts,
               t
         WHERE created_at > t.START
           AND created_at < t. END
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       ttopics AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               posts_count
          FROM topics,
               t
         WHERE created_at > t.START
           AND created_at < t. END
       ),
       tc AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS topics_created
          FROM ttopics
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       twr AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS topics_with_replies
          FROM ttopics
         WHERE posts_count > 1
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       tv AS (
        SELECT user_id,
               COUNT(DISTINCT(topic_id)) AS topics_viewed
          FROM topic_views,
               t
         WHERE viewed_at > t.START
           AND viewed_at < t. END
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       likes AS (
        SELECT post_actions.user_id AS given_by_user_id,
               posts.user_id AS received_by_user_id
          FROM t,
               post_actions
          LEFT JOIN posts
            ON post_actions.post_id = posts.id
         WHERE post_actions.created_at > t.START
           AND post_actions.created_at < t. END
           AND post_action_type_id = 2
       ),
       lg AS (
        SELECT given_by_user_id AS user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS likes_given
          FROM likes
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       lr AS (
        SELECT received_by_user_id AS user_id,
               COUNT(1) AS likes_received
          FROM likes
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       e AS (
        SELECT email,
               user_id
          FROM user_emails u
         WHERE u."primary" = TRUE
       ) SELECT pr.user_id,
       username,
       name,
       email,
       visits,
       COALESCE(topics_viewed, 0) AS topics_viewed,
       COALESCE(posts_read, 0) AS posts_read,
       COALESCE(posts_created, 0) AS posts_created,
       COALESCE(topics_created, 0) AS topics_created,
       COALESCE(topics_with_replies, 0) AS topics_with_replies,
       COALESCE(likes_given, 0) AS likes_given,
       COALESCE(likes_received, 0) AS likes_received
  FROM pr
  LEFT JOIN tv USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN pc USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN tc USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN twr USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN lg USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN lr USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN e USING (user_id)
  LEFT JOIN users
    ON pr.user_id = users.id
 ORDER BY visits DESC,
          posts_read DESC,
          posts_created DESC;

Question: Data Explorer built-in query: Most Active Lurkers. active users without posts and excessive read times, it accepts a post_read_count parameter that sets the threshold for posts read.

WITH posts_by_user AS (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS posts,
               user_id
          FROM posts
         GROUP BY user_id
       ),
       posts_read_by_user AS (
        SELECT SUM(posts_read) AS posts_read,
               user_id
          FROM user_visits
         GROUP BY user_id
       ) SELECT u.id,
       u.username_lower AS "username",
       u.created_at,
       u.last_seen_at,
       COALESCE(pbu.posts, 0) AS "posts_created",
       COALESCE(prbu.posts_read, 0) AS "posts_read"
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN posts_by_user pbu
    ON pbu.user_id = u.id
  LEFT JOIN posts_read_by_user prbu
    ON prbu.user_id = u.id
 WHERE u.active = TRUE
   AND posts IS NULL
   AND posts_read > 100
 ORDER BY u.id;

WITH target_users AS (
        SELECT u.id AS user_id
          FROM users u
          JOIN group_users gu
            ON gu.user_id = u.id
          JOIN groups g
            ON g.id = gu.group_id
         WHERE g.name = 'trust_level_0'
           AND gu.created_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE
       ),
       target_posts AS (
        SELECT p.id,
               p.user_id
          FROM posts p
          JOIN topics t
            ON t.id = p.topic_id
         WHERE CASE WHEN FALSE THEN TRUE
                    ELSE t.archetype = 'regular'
                     END

           AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND p.created_at::date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
           AND p.created_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE

  FROM target_users tu
  LEFT OUTER JOIN target_posts tp
    ON tp.user_id = tu.user_id
 GROUP BY tu.user_id
 ORDER BY reply_count DESC,

WITH DATA AS (
        SELECT tag_id,
               EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS YEAR
          FROM topic_tags
       ) SELECT YEAR,
       rank,
       name,
       qt
  FROM (
        SELECT tag_id,
               COUNT(tag_id) AS qt,
               YEAR,
               rank() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(tag_id) DESC) AS rank

         GROUP BY YEAR,

    ON tags.id = rnk.tag_id

 ORDER BY YEAR DESC, qt DESC;

       c.name category,
       COUNT(p.post_id) AS qt

          c.name,
          p.year
 ORDER BY p.year DESC,
          qt DESC;

Question: Show average hours to first response by day.

SELECT t.created_at::date AS DAY,
       AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.created_at - t.created_at)) / 3600.0) AS avg_hours_to_first_response
  FROM topics t
  JOIN posts p
    ON p.topic_id = t.id
   AND p.post_number = 2
 WHERE t.archetype = 'regular'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY DAY
 ORDER BY DAY;

Question: What are the top 100 topics by page views in the last 30 days?

SELECT tvs.topic_id,
       t.title AS topic_title,
       SUM(tvs.anonymous_views) AS total_anonymous_views,
       SUM(tvs.logged_in_views) AS total_logged_in_views,
       SUM(tvs.anonymous_views + tvs.logged_in_views) AS total_views
  FROM topic_view_stats tvs
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = tvs.topic_id
 WHERE tvs.viewed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY tvs.topic_id,
          t.title
 ORDER BY total_views DESC,
          tvs.topic_id
 LIMIT 100;

Question: Find topics whose page views spiked yesterday compared with their previous 7 day average.

WITH daily_views AS (
        SELECT tvs.topic_id,
               tvs.viewed_at,
               SUM(tvs.anonymous_views + tvs.logged_in_views) AS total_views
          FROM topic_view_stats tvs
         WHERE tvs.viewed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 days'
           AND tvs.viewed_at < CURRENT_DATE
         GROUP BY tvs.topic_id,
                  tvs.viewed_at
       ),
       previous_average AS (
        SELECT dv.topic_id,
               AVG(dv.total_views) AS avg_previous_views
          FROM daily_views dv
         WHERE dv.viewed_at < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
         GROUP BY dv.topic_id
       ),
       yesterday AS (
        SELECT dv.topic_id,
               dv.total_views AS yesterday_views
          FROM daily_views dv
         WHERE dv.viewed_at = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
       ) SELECT y.topic_id,
       t.title AS topic_title,
       y.yesterday_views,
       pa.avg_previous_views
  FROM yesterday y
  JOIN previous_average pa
    ON pa.topic_id = y.topic_id
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = y.topic_id
 WHERE y.yesterday_views > pa.avg_previous_views * 2
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 ORDER BY y.yesterday_views DESC,
          y.topic_id
 LIMIT 50;

  pinned_globally boolean,
  pinned_until timestamp without time zone,
  fancy_title character varying,

  featured_link character varying,
  reviewable_score double precision,

Notes:
- Use read-only PostgreSQL SELECT SQL.
- topic_view_stats is Discourse's per-topic per-day aggregate page-view table.
- topic_view_stats has one row per topic_id and viewed_at date, with anonymous_views and logged_in_views counters.
- Total page views for a topic/date range are SUM(anonymous_views + logged_in_views).
- Discourse's core topic_view_stats report joins topic_view_stats to topics, groups by topic_id and topic title, filters viewed_at BETWEEN start and end dates, and orders by total views descending.
- The /t/:topic_id/view-stats.json endpoint returns per-day stats for one public topic, ordered by viewed_at; its JSON views value is anonymous_views + logged_in_views.
- TopicViewItem.add increments topic_view_stats when a raw topic_views row is accepted. topic_views is lower-level raw deduplicated view data; topic_view_stats is the better table for page views per topic over time.
- Exclude deleted topics with topics.deleted_at IS NULL when reporting public topic rankings.

Question: Show topics with page views in topic_view_stats but no raw topic_views rows in the same date range.

SELECT tvs.topic_id,
       t.title AS topic_title,
       SUM(tvs.anonymous_views + tvs.logged_in_views) AS stats_total_views,
       COUNT(tv.topic_id) AS raw_topic_view_rows
  FROM topic_view_stats tvs
  JOIN topics t
    ON t.id = tvs.topic_id
  LEFT JOIN topic_views tv
    ON tv.topic_id = tvs.topic_id
   AND tv.viewed_at = tvs.viewed_at
 WHERE tvs.viewed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY tvs.topic_id,
          t.title
HAVING COUNT(tv.topic_id) = 0
 ORDER BY stats_total_views DESC,
          tvs.topic_id
 LIMIT 50;
